name: Kiriomachi
source:
That town was always enveloped in mist.
Chased out of the poorhouse they never got used to living in despite how long they spent there...
What does the future have in store for them?


[Translation of [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ309041.html]DL Site story[/url].]
